description: This PHP source file defines the ReturnReason class in the Opencart admin module, specifically for managing return reasons within the localisation context. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving return reason data from the database, including handling multiple languages and cache invalidation.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Model class responsible for CRUD operations related to return reasons in the database, including multilingual descriptions and cache management.

methods.name: addReturnReason
methods.description: Creates a new return reason record in multiple languages and returns its ID.

methods.name: editReturnReason
methods.description: Replaces the existing return reason with a new set of multilingual descriptions.

methods.name: deleteReturnReason
methods.description: Deletes a specific return reason by its ID.

methods.name: deleteReturnReasonsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return reason records associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getReturnReason
methods.description: Retrieves a return reason record for a specific ID and the current language.

methods.name: getReturnReasons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return reasons filtered and sorted according to provided criteria, with caching support.

methods.name: getTotalReturnReasons
methods.description: Returns the total count of return reasons for the current or specified language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Inserts a new description for a return reason in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return reason descriptions associated with a specific language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return reason description for given return reason ID and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific return reason ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all return reason descriptions associated with a specific language.
